notes: Stories refined for stricter ARCH-001 compliance, explicit contract enforcement, and test coverage alignment with UAT and regression baselines. No new IDs created.

change_log.value: Explicitly define service interface contracts using Pydantic schemas for all facade-to-domain and domain-to-infrastructure interactions, including strict typing, validation rules, and serialization boundaries, ensuring zero cross-layer leakage and enforceable contracts per ARCH-001.

Refactor and isolate core business logic into discrete domain services (provider_search, specialty, clinical_trials, provider_detail, consent, safety), enforcing stateless behavior, explicit inputs/outputs, and elimination of shared mutable state or cross-service coupling.

Align application facades and FastAPI endpoints to consume modular services strictly via defined contracts, preserving external API behavior, maintaining tool_router compatibility, and preventing direct domain or infrastructure access outside facade boundaries.
change_log.note: Added boundary enforcement for API layer

change_log.value: Implement dependency wiring and service orchestration across layers (facade → domain → infrastructure) using explicit dependency injection patterns, ensuring unidirectional flow, no circular dependencies, and centralized configuration aligned with ARCH-001.
change_log.note: Specified dependency injection and config control

change_log.value: Validate refactor via unit, integration, regression, and UAT-aligned test suites ensuring contract adherence, service isolation, and full behavioral parity with pre-refactor baseline, including coverage of tool_router flows and end-to-end chat scenarios.
change_log.note: Expanded test scope to include UAT and tool flows
